test_tz_localize_utc: test tz_localize on a DataFrame or Series index to localize naive timestamps to UTC
test_tz_localize_axis1: test tz_localize with axis=1 to localize column index to UTC instead of row index
test_tz_localize_naive_raises: test tz_localize raises TypeError when called on an already tz-aware index
test_tz_localize_copy_behavior: test tz_localize returns a new object and leaves the original DataFrame or Series unchanged
test_tz_localize_with_timezone: test tz_localize to assign a timezone such as UTC to a pandas DataFrame or Series index
